/pages/23/summary: TEILEKLAR is a dedicated commerce area with vehicle and parts context. The shop is in preparation. Without approved product, price and delivery data, no availability, fit or purchase completion is claimed.

/pages/23/sections/0/body: TEILEKLAR is a dedicated commerce area with vehicle and parts context. The shop is in preparation. Without approved product, price and delivery data, no availability, fit or purchase completion is claimed.
/pages/23/sections/1/body: TEILEKLAR brings parts, vehicle reference and workshop together. You describe your vehicle and the part you need; matching options and next steps appear as soon as an approved parts inventory is available. Until then, no invented matches, prices or delivery times are shown.
